messages:
Ethan Park: Hi team, just opened my new hire kit and the USB-C->Ethernet dongle is missing. Dock and monitor arrived. :thinking:
it-support-bot: Sorry Ethan — logged ticket IT-5238 and notified Shipping. Can you share the packing slip SKU?
Ethan Park: SKU: RWD-ONB-24. No photo, I recycled the outer box already.
Maya Lopez: Welcome Ethan! Quick workaround: phone hotspot + USB tethering works until the dongle arrives. I can bring a spare from the office if you want.
Ethan Park: That would be great, thanks Maya. I'm at desk 4C.
Facilities: Noted — also saw a loose cable clip on one monitor this week, filing QA note for assembly team.
Shipping Bot: Replacement dongle requested. Tracking: 1ZABC1234509876543. ETA 2 business days. Ref SHIP-101334.
Ethan Park: Thanks everyone. Will test and post `ifconfig` output here if connectivity acts up.
it-support-bot: No return required. Hold onto any foam pouch for 48h in case support requests a photo.
